received_proposals.exact_message: I endorse the cooperative price of 64. Maintaining this agreement maximizes our cumulative profits compared to deviation or competition. I commit to 64 provided others reciprocate.

I propose we jointly set prices at A=64, B=64, C=64 for rounds 9 through 13. This arrangement maintains our previous cooperative agreement and ensures consistent profits for all three firms. Do you agree to this proposal?
